decision: Retain the DOS 6.0-identical shared memory arena structure and allocation constants.
evidence: The source is byte-identical to DOS 6.0 and astro.
The file defines a 16-byte arena header with signature, owner, size, reserved bytes and owner name, as well as allocation strategy masks.
dos/alloc.asm and several BIOS and COMMAND modules include this file.
The prior ALLOC comparison matched target bytes except external branch displacement bytes (file-review-043-alloc.json).
The prior COMMAND LOADHI comparison, including highload.inc which uses arena definitions, matched 1697 non-relocation bytes and 73 internal branches (file-review-128-loadhi.json).
limitations: Existing module comparisons support the definitions exercised there, not every use of this shared include; complete target binary identity and relocation values require final builds.
